info.name: Sukrtya Siwan
info.description:
Sukrtya Siwan backend API.

| Area | Method | Path | Auth |
|------|--------|------|------|
| Login | POST | `/api/auth/login` | None (JSON body) |
| Current user | GET | `/api/auth/me` | Bearer JWT |
| Master roster | GET | `/api/me/master-context` | Bearer JWT |
| Excel import | POST | `/api/admin/masters/import-excel` | None (multipart `file`) |

**`{{baseUrl}}`** defaults to `http://localhost:8081` (`server.port`).

**Token:** Run **Login — admin** or **Login — CHO**; the Tests script stores `{{accessToken}}`. Use **Me (JWT)** requests after login.

**Secrets:** Admin defaults `{{adminUsername}}` / `{{adminPassword}}`; CHO uses 10-digit `{{choUsername}}` / `{{choPassword}}` (`User@123` unless changed in `application.properties`).

variable.description: API root (scheme + host + port). Override if SERVER_PORT differs.
Set automatically by Login requests on 200; use as Bearer token.
10-digit portal username (CHO mobile from Excel import).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public endpoints. Successful login saves `accessToken` to collection variables.

request.description: Response JSON: `accessToken`, `tokenType` (Bearer), `expiresInSeconds`, `role`, `username`, `displayName`. Credentials from `app.seed.default-admin-*` unless overridden.
Username = CHO **mobile** (10 digits). Default password from `app.seed.cho-collector-default-password` (usually `User@123`).

item.name: Me (JWT)
item.description: Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. Run a **Login** under **Auth** first.

request.description: Roster for the logged-in user: `scope` = `ALL` (admin) or `MAPPED_FACILITIES` (data collector), plus `facilities[]` with nested district, block, facility, `userPrimaryFacilityMapping`, and `staff[]` (active CHO/ANM/ASHA roles; ASHA rows include `supervisorAssignmentId`).

item.name: Admin
item.description: Master data import (no JWT in current dev config).

formdata.description: Master roster (.xlsx or .xls). Form field name must be exactly `file`.

request.description: Multipart upload. **200** success JSON with import counts/messages; **400** on validation/read errors.
